close_reason: Committed in e5b9c7b: fix(mail-server): enforce maxSizeScript in SieveScript/validate. handle_sieve_validate now reads max_sieve_script_bytes and short-circuits with type=tooLarge before calling validate_sieve_script, mirroring the existing set-path size-check at sieve.rs:505-529 (create) and 680-705 (update). Adapted to validate's inline json! error shape rather than SetError-wrapped notCreated/notUpdated. Missing blobs still fall through to validate_sieve_script per its trait contract. Added test sieve_validate_too_large (test 19) using VALID_SIEVE_SCRIPT (5 bytes) + 4-byte limit; the valid script is the discriminator — without the guard the response would be error:null. The optional shared-helper refactor from the proposed-fix was deliberately not done — validate's response shape diverges enough from set's that the helper would only abstract the backend-call portion. All gates clean: fmt, clippy --all-targets, test --workspace, RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D-warnings doc -p jmap-mail-server.
title: Security: handle_sieve_validate skips the max_sieve_script_bytes enforcement that the SieveBackend trait doc requires (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/sieve.rs:1139)
